title: Convert a certified block energy envelope to the actual detector window
statement: If integral over a certified T block of |e|^2<=T d_j^2,a contained window of lengthW has RMS error<=sqrt(T/W)d_j. Averaged half-combined detector error is then<=(1+R)d_window+d_window^2/2 for stationary |h|<=1. Complete-block RMS does not imply a pointwise short-window bound.

requires: An independently acquired integrated field-error/settling envelope for a complete block
Actual windowW and added receiver/load path delays included in T
provides: Conservative detector transient charge for actual integration windows
assumptions: Stationary scattering and quiet accessible power do not acquire hidden decay or a settling time
This unit proves the conversion;it does not audit the older complete finite-memory theorem
costs: Charge all raw powers,reference/signal photons,combiner loss,calibration,mask writes,load switching,settling and reset;no free parameter,clock or arbitrarily strong local oscillator.
contract.units: Dimensionless power per incident feed-power unit;field amplitude is its square root. r,z,s are complex reflection amplitudes;R is reference amplitude. Physical photon/time calibration remains an acquired input.
contract.obstruction: No seconds or hidden-energy decay law inferred from a stationary numerical backplane model.
